resolution.note: feat(slice): name the review findings when review fails (t-4sesbm3)

title: slice run names the review findings when review fails
body:
Outcome: when the review stage fails, `krn slice run` prints the record path and each BLOCKING finding (severity, path:line, title, one line each) instead of only "review failed exit 3", so the lead decides without opening the record.
Evidence: PR #204 (t-4bc72d3): `slice review exit=3: review failed exit 3`; the lead needed jq over records/1.json to see the one finding.
Proof: an observer whose stub review prints a FAIL record with one finding; the cause names the record path and the finding.
